summary: New Engineering Guide article: a trunk-based branching strategy (one long-lived main, short-lived feat/fix branches, squash merge, tag-driven rollback) generalized from this project's own doc. Project-specific ticket-prefix examples, concrete workflow filenames, and project-specific cross-references replaced with generic framing; kept the Mermaid gitGraph (with a note on why each merge needs a distinct custom commit id, since reusing one label fails to render) and the environment/branch-protection/rollback tables as adaptable templates.
